scenarios.name: CATEGORY-SIMPLIFICATION — new patient generic booking never asks appointment category, only location then new/existing

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent asks the LOCATION GATE question only ("Are you coming to Raymond Terrace or Tea Gardens?"). It must NOT ask about appointment category, billing type, DVA, EPC, CCMP, care plan, or any variant other than location. Zero tool calls this turn.

scenarios.name: CATEGORY-SIMPLIFICATION — new patient full flow resolves to Initial ID with zero category question

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment please.
Are you coming to Raymond Terrace or Tea Gardens?
Have you been to Raymond Terrace and Tea Gardens Osteopaths before?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent speaks exactly one filler phrase, then calls universal_router intent="confirm_service" with payload appointment_type_id="412451910654630891", appointment_type="New Patient Raymond Terrace", patient_status="new", variant_type="initial", business_id="412451910923065987", business_name="Raymond Terrace". No category/billing-type question was ever asked anywhere in this conversation.

scenarios.name: CATEGORY-SIMPLIFICATION — caller unprompted mentions DVA, agent proceeds gracefully without a DVA-specific question

history.content: Hi, I'm a DVA patient, I'd like to book an appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent does NOT ask a DVA-specific question, does NOT say DVA is unavailable, and does NOT get stuck or loop. It proceeds exactly like any other booking request -- asks the LOCATION GATE question ("Are you coming to Raymond Terrace or Tea Gardens?"). The word DVA is matched to STANDARD in the CATEGORY TABLE and produces no special handling.

scenarios.name: CATEGORY-SIMPLIFICATION — caller unprompted mentions EPC/care plan, agent proceeds gracefully without the old 81350 item-number question

history.content: I've got an EPC care plan from my GP, can I book in?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent does NOT ask "Is this a standard EPC referral, or the 81350 item number?" (that question no longer exists) and does NOT mention EPC at all. It proceeds like a normal booking -- asks the LOCATION GATE question ("Are you coming to Raymond Terrace or Tea Gardens?"). No tool call this turn.

scenarios.name: CATEGORY-SIMPLIFICATION — practitioner-only path (Bruce) still works, only location + new/existing asked

history.content: Can I book in with Bruce please?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PRACTITIONER-ONLY PATH fires: practitioner_preference stored as Bruce Sutton, agent proceeds to STANDARD branch and asks the LOCATION GATE question ("Are you coming to Raymond Terrace or Tea Gardens?"). No question about appointment category/billing type is asked.
